player.name: Xarax
player.concept: I must discover who I was and what happened to me, before my twitching knife hand writes a tragedy in blood.

backstory.text: I can’t remember who I am. Occasionally, a dark force takes over me, and I can’t resist the dark urge to kill. I must discover who I was and what happened to me before my twitching knife hand writes a tragedy in blood.
backstory.summary: Xarax has no memory of who they are or what happened to them. They took this case to uncover their past before the dark force that sometimes takes over drives them to kill.
ideals: Discover the truth of their past
flaws: Cannot resist the dark urge to kill when it takes over
